notes: «- يعني ابن عبد الواحد -» and «- المعنى -» are editor glosses and are left out
«عن الأوزاعي» closes the three «ح» branches; it is written once after the last «ح», so it is in the shared tail (rule 3)
«أنبئت أن سعيد» is passive: the informant is not named, so «أنبئت» is kept as an unnamed link (rule 8)
«حدث عن أبيه» names no one: the father of سعيد is a relation (rule 7)
